title: Post an incoming guest check and clear a completed check from a slide check rack
instruction: Clear the completed pink guest check from the left side of the slide check rack into the aluminum out-tray, and post the new green guest check from the input stand into the right side of the rack.
context: O*NET 35-2011.00 (https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/35-2011.00) and 35-2015.00 (https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/35-2015.00) list 'Read food order slips or receive verbal instructions as to food required by patron, and prepare and cook food according to instructions.' While chain kitchens largely use digital KDS screens, independent diner and counter pass bars use manual slide check racks (San Jamar CK6518A) with NCCO #525/#526 checks and ticket pans (Winco ALXP-1310H). Closest accepted task TK-EZCH6H (Change two shelf-edge price tickets in a clear ticket strip) lowers rigid 60 x 39 mm tickets into a floor-supported trough while holding a hinged flap open; here there is no floor or flap—171.5 mm flexible cardstock wedges upward into loose rolling spheres and peels out downward.
setup: Station table (top z = 0.7475 m); robot base frame x forward, y left. Pass riser (fixed 3D-printed PLA frame, split-bed STLs in make_fixtures.py): rear-cantilevered pass bar C-clamped to the rear tabletop holding the check rack's bottom edge at z = 1.0175 m (270 mm clear pass space underneath). Slide check rack (fixed): San Jamar CK6518A 18 in anodized aluminum rack, 50.8 mm H x 457.2 mm W x 19.05 mm D catalog outer dimensions, rear outer face bolted at x = 0.3750 m, centred at y = 0.0 m; internal channel (unmeasured model estimates: 1.8 mm walls, 12.5 mm exposed lower rear apron, 4.0 mm bottom throat, 24.5 deg front ramp, 2.0 mm end caps) holding 31 loose 12.7 mm (2.68 g) green glass spheres. Guest checks (free, 4 hinged strips each, 31.5 / 45.0 / 47.5 / 47.5 mm): 88.9 mm W x 171.5 mm H (3.5 x 6.75 in) 18-line single-copy cardboard checks with red 4.0 mm top header (unmeasured model assumptions: 2.00 g net mass, 0.22 mm caliper, 3.0 GPa modulus). Completed pink check (NCCO #526) starts suspended in the left half of the rack at y = +0.115 m (top edge 41 mm above z = 1.0175 m). Incoming green check (NCCO #525) stands upright in a fixed 3D-printed PLA input stand (60 x 56 x 84 mm core, 1.5 mm clear vertical slot between two 5.0 mm walls on 6.5 mm centres) at (0.255, -0.055) m. Out-tray (fixed): Winco ALXP-1310H quarter-size aluminum sheet pan, 244.5 mm (X) x 330.2 mm (Y) x 28.6 mm (Z) official outer dimensions (unmeasured model estimates: 4.0 mm floor, 4.5 mm rim walls -> 235.5 x 321.2 mm modeled clear inner bed) centred at (0.255, +0.180) m.
scoring: Possible scores: 0, 0.5, 1.0. Goal-only in either operation order and for any valid insertion or removal technique, evaluated over the final 21 control steps (1.0 s at 20 Hz): 0.5 if the completed pink check (#526) is clear below the rack (highest corner >= 50 mm below the rack bottom, z <= 0.9675 m), free of solid-wall/floor embedding (<= 0.25 mm contact compliance), and all 40 strip corners lie inside the out-tray's 235.5 x 321.2 mm inner bed (x in [0.13725, 0.37275] m, y in [0.01940, 0.34060] m) with z in [floor - 0.25 mm, rim + 10 mm] ([0.75125, 0.78610] m, z_max > 0.7515 m) and its mass-weighted CoM supported inside the inner XY bed at z in (0.7515, 0.7761] m; +0.5 if the incoming green check (#525) is seated upright (root tilt <= 15 deg from vertical) in the rack's right active-order zone (CoM y in [-0.200, -0.020] m, all corners within the end caps y in [-0.22685, +0.22685] m), with its top edge 25.0 to 49.25 mm above the rack bottom (z_top in [1.0425, 1.06675] m, under the 49.0 mm channel roof plus 0.25 mm contact compliance), its bottom edge hanging freely >= 50 mm above the table and >= 100 mm below the rack bottom (z_bot in [0.7975, 0.9175] m), and its in-channel strips occupying free channel space between the front ramp/fascia and rear wall (<= 0.25 mm solid compliance). Any positive score requires certified surface-to-surface clearance >= 80.0 mm from both arms' distal links, grippers and fingers to both checks, the rack, out-tray, pass riser, input stand and all 31 spheres across all 21 samples, and visible check stillness strictly < 1.0 mm maximum 3-D all-pairs corner excursion over the 21 samples across all 80 check corners (fixed apparatus; hidden internal sphere creep inside the opaque channel is diagnostic only). Permanent 0 if any sphere escapes the rack channel or a check crosses a solid wall midplane. Real trial: verify no escaped glass spheres on the table/pan and >= 80 mm arm clearance with a metric ruler and overhead/side 20 Hz video (strictly < 1.0 mm maximum 3-D displacement of the visible checks over every pair of frames in the final 1.0 s, 21 frames); verify the pink check lies inside the ALXP-1310H inner walls below rim + 10 mm and >= 50 mm below the rack; measure the green check's exposed hang length below the CK6518A bottom edge (122.25 to 146.5 mm exposed => 25.0 to 49.25 mm seated inside the 171.5 mm card), bottom clearance >= 50 mm above the table, centre 20 to 200 mm right of rack centre (y in [-200, -20] mm), and plumb tilt <= 15 deg.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed; replace any creased or dog-eared guest check with a fresh sheet from the NCCO #526 (pink) or #525 (green) pad. Confirm all glass spheres roll freely inside the CK6518A channel without escaping, empty the ALXP-1310H pan, seat the pink #526 check 41 mm up at y = +0.115 m (130.5 mm hanging plumb below the rack), and stand the green #525 check upright in the 1.5 mm clear slot of the input stand at (0.255, -0.055) m.
fidelity: Catalog outlines: CK6518A rack, ALXP-1310H pan and NCCO #525/#526 checks. Rack internals, 31 glass beads, pan floor/walls, 2.00 g check mass, 0.22 mm caliper, 3 GPa modulus and friction are unmeasured estimates. Checks use four rigid strips with three hinges; creasing, tearing and indentation are omitted. Internal bead creep is diagnostic only (opaque rack). Native tests validate the model, not hardware.
